formattedAddress: No. 5號, Alley 22, Lane 553, Section 4, Zhongxiao E Rd, Xinren Village, Xinyi District, Taipei City, Taiwan 110

text.text: Very few brunches on the menu. Disappointed. Out of salmon at the beginning of open hours. We ordered truffle french fries, but they were cold, not warm. It was bizarre. It was just a quiet place to grab some coffee sitting outdoors. It was too dark to sit indoors. The coffee was good, though. It's not the place to fully enjoy a meal. You can find more exciting and cozy places in this area near the park.

text.text: I think the most noteworthy aspect of this café is its interior design. The furniture, from the dining tables to the shelves and chairs, gave off a European vibe. The café itself offers a relaxing atmosphere with a quaint, French small-town feel. I visited on a weekday afternoon, so it was not too crowded, but I imagine it gets busy on weekends. It's a good idea to make a reservation before you visit. The brunch plate is decent—while not particularly impressive, it is above average compared to other cafés in Taipei.
